description_en: We sell Apartment 2+1+2 in Linze, Near "2 Lions". The apartment has a total area of ​​97 m2 and is organized in a living room together with the kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony with a free view. It is located on the 2nd floor in a new and well-managed building. It also includes a parking post. The area is quiet and offers every possible facility. Has ownership documentation.
